what: Five injured, one critically, in shooting at Virginia State University

clean_source_blocks.text: Five people have been injured, one critically, in a shooting at Virginia State University which involved multiple suspects, the university has said. Officers responded to the incident outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday. Five individuals, who were all found with gunshot wounds, were taken to local hospitals. Four had injuries which were not deemed to be life-threatening, the university said. It was not immediately clear if any suspects have been arrested. The BBC has approached local police for comment. A temporary lockdown on the campus has since been lifted but a "significant" law enforcement presence is still on site, the university confirmed in a statement. It added that Chesterfield County Police are leading the investigation with help from other local law enforcement and campus police.

Five people were shot outside campus dormitories early Saturday The Virginia State University shooting left five people injured early Saturday and triggered a campus lockdown as police launched an investigation involving multiple suspects. Officers responding to the area near the university's Quad Annexes found five people suffering from gunshot wounds outside campus dormitories. All five victims were transported to hospitals. According to Chesterfield County Police, one victim who was initially reported to have life-threatening injuries is now in critical condition, while the other four suffered non-life-threatening injuries. Authorities have not publicly identified the victims or announced what may have led to the shooting. Virginia State University said the shooting involved multiple suspects and instructed the campus community to avoid the area and follow law enforcement directions.

Aug. 15 (UPI) -- Five people were injured by multiple shooters at Virginia State University in Ettrick, Va., early Saturday morning. Police responded to the area outside of residence halls around 1:30 a.m. and found five people with gunshot wounds. They were taken to the hospital, and one is in critical-condition. The others had injuries that weren't life-threatening. The campus, which had not started fall-semester classes yet, was put on lockdown until about 8:30 Saturday morning. But police have not said if anyone has been arrested. Residence halls opened a week ago, and classes are set to begin Monday. The Chesterfield County Police Department is investigating the incident with the help of VSU police, the Hanover County Sheriff's Office and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives.
Multiple suspects were involved in the incident in the early hours of Saturday, the university said.

Five people have been injured, one critically, in a shooting at Virginia State University which involved multiple suspects, the university has said.

Officers responded to the incident outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday.

Five individuals, who were all found with gunshot wounds, were taken to local hospitals. Four had injuries which were not deemed to be life-threatening, the university said.

It was not immediately clear if any suspects have been arrested. The BBC has approached local police for comment.

A temporary lockdown on the campus has since been lifted but a "significant" law enforcement presence is still on site, the university confirmed in a statement.

It added that Chesterfield County Police are leading the investigation with help from other local law enforcement and campus police.

Virginia State University (VSU) has about 5,000 students and is just over 20 miles south of Richmond, the capital of the US state of Virginia.

It is also one of the country's historically black colleges and universities.

Such institutions were created to provide higher education to disenfranchised African Americans, who were otherwise prohibited from attending most colleges.

According to the university's website, classes for the new term were set to begin on Monday and campus dormitories opened for returning students on Friday.

The campus, which had not started fall-semester classes yet, was put on lockdown until about 8:30 Saturday morning. But police have not said if anyone has been arrested. Residence halls opened a week ago, and classes are set to begin Monday.

The Chesterfield County Police Department is investigating the incident with the help of VSU police, the Hanover County Sheriff's Office and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives.

[Lähde: MARCA | URL: https://www.marca.com/en/lifestyle/us-news/2026/08/15/virginia-state-university-shooting-leaves-5-injured-one-critical-as-police-search-for-multiple-suspects.html]
Five people were shot outside campus dormitories early Saturday

The Virginia State University shooting left five people injured early Saturday and triggered a campus lockdown as police launched an investigation involving multiple suspects. Officers responding to the area near the university's Quad Annexes found five people suffering from gunshot wounds outside campus dormitories.

All five victims were transported to hospitals. According to Chesterfield County Police, one victim who was initially reported to have life-threatening injuries is now in critical condition, while the other four suffered non-life-threatening injuries. Authorities have not publicly identified the victims or announced what may have led to the shooting.

Virginia State University said the shooting involved multiple suspects and instructed the campus community to avoid the area and follow law enforcement directions.

VSU Police and Chesterfield County Police are leading the investigation, with assistance from federal and local agencies, including the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives..

The shooting comes at a particularly sensitive moment for Virginia State University, a historically Black university in Ettrick, Virginia.

Students recently began moving into residence halls and classes are scheduled to begin Monday, meaning many new and returning students were already on campus when the shooting occurred.

Investigators are now working to determine who was responsible, how many people were involved and what triggered the gunfire.

Police have not publicly announced a motive or arrests, and authorities said additional information will be released as the investigation develops.

payload.title: Viisi haavoittui ampumisessa Virginia State Universityn kampuksella
payload.summary: Viisi ihmistä haavoittui varhain lauantaina Virginia State Universityn kampuksella. Yksi uhreista on kriittisessä tilassa, ja poliisi tutkii usean epäillyn osuutta ampumiseen.
payload.content:
Viisi ihmistä haavoittui varhain lauantaina ampumisessa Virginia State Universityn kampuksella Ettrickissä Yhdysvaltain Virginian osavaltiossa. Yksi sairaalaan viedyistä uhreista on kriittisessä tilassa, kun taas neljän muun vammat eivät viranomaisten tämänhetkisen arvion mukaan ole hengenvaarallisia. Yliopiston mukaan tapaukseen liittyi useita epäiltyjä. Tapaus käynnisti kampuksella sulkutilan ja usean viranomaisen yhteisen tutkinnan.

## Ampuminen tapahtui asuntoloiden ulkopuolella

Poliisit saapuivat kampuksen opiskelija-asuntoloiden ulkopuolelle noin kello 1.28 paikallista aikaa eli kello 5.28 GMT-aikaa. Paikalta löydettiin viisi ampumahaavoja saanutta ihmistä, ja heidät kaikki kuljetettiin alueen sairaaloihin. Tapahtumapaikaksi ilmoitettiin Quad Annexes -asuntoloiden ympäristö.

Chesterfieldin piirikunnan poliisin mukaan yhden uhrin vammoja pidettiin aluksi hengenvaarallisina. Myöhemmässä päivityksessä hänen tilansa kuvattiin kriittiseksi. Neljän muun uhrin vammojen ei arvioitu uhkaavan henkeä.

Yliopisto kertoi ampumiseen liittyneen useita epäiltyjä. Tapahtuman jälkeen kampus asetettiin väliaikaiseen sulkutilaan, ja alueella olevia kehotettiin välttämään ampumispaikan ympäristöä sekä noudattamaan lainvalvontaviranomaisten ohjeita.

Sulkutila päättyi noin kello 8.30 lauantaiaamuna. Poliisin toiminta kampuksella ei kuitenkaan päättynyt rajoituksen purkamiseen, sillä yliopisto kertoi alueelle jääneen huomattavan määrän lainvalvontaviranomaisia. Tapahtumapaikan tutkinta jatkui.

## Tutkinnassa mukana useita viranomaisia

Tutkintaa johtaa Chesterfieldin piirikunnan poliisi. Sitä avustaa Virginia State Universityn oma poliisi. Mukana ovat myös Hanoverin piirikunnan sheriffinvirasto sekä liittovaltion alkoholi-, tupakka-, ampuma-ase- ja räjähdevirasto ATF. Yliopiston mukaan tutkintaan osallistuu lisäksi muita paikallisia lainvalvontaviranomaisia.

Ampuminen sattui juuri ennen syyslukukauden opetuksen alkua. Opiskelija-asuntolat olivat avautuneet viikkoa aiemmin. Varsinaiset oppitunnit eivät olleet vielä alkaneet, vaan opetuksen oli määrä käynnistyä maanantaina.

Poliisi ei ollut lauantaina kertonut, oliko ketään otettu kiinni. Uhrien henkilöllisyyksiä ei ole julkistettu, eikä viranomaisilta ollut saatu tietoa siitä, mikä ampumiseen johti. Tapahtumien tarkka kulku ja epäiltyjen roolit olivat yhä selvitettävinä.
summary_bullets: Viisi ihmistä sai ampumahaavoja opiskelija-asuntoloiden ulkopuolella.
Yksi uhreista on kriittisessä tilassa, mutta neljän muun vammat eivät ole hengenvaarallisia.
Kampuksen sulkutila on purettu, ja usean viranomaisen tutkinta jatkuu.

Five people were shot outside campus dormitories early Saturday

The Virginia State University shooting left five people injured early Saturday and triggered a campus lockdown as police launched an investigation involving multiple suspects. Officers responding to the area near the university's Quad Annexes found five people suffering from gunshot wounds outside campus dormitories.

All five victims were transported to hospitals. According to Chesterfield County Police, one victim who was initially reported to have life-threatening injuries is now in critical condition, while the other four suffered non-life-threatening injuries. Authorities have not publicly identified the victims or announced what may have led to the shooting.

Virginia State University said the shooting involved multiple suspects and instructed the campus community to avoid the area and follow law enforcement directions.

VSU Police and Chesterfield County Police are leading the investigation, with assistance from federal and local agencies, including the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives..

The shooting comes at a particularly sensitive moment for Virginia State University, a historically Black university in Ettrick, Virginia.

Students recently began moving into residence halls and classes are scheduled to begin Monday, meaning many new and returning students were already on campus when the shooting occurred.

Investigators are now working to determine who was responsible, how many people were involved and what triggered the gunfire.

Police have not publicly announced a motive or arrests, and authorities said additional information will be released as the investigation develops.
article.summary: Viisi ihmistä haavoittui varhain lauantaina Virginia State Universityn kampuksella. Yksi uhreista on kriittisessä tilassa, ja poliisi tutkii usean epäillyn osuutta ampumiseen.
article.content:
Viisi ihmistä haavoittui varhain lauantaina ampumisessa Virginia State Universityn kampuksella Ettrickissä Yhdysvaltain Virginian osavaltiossa. Yksi sairaalaan viedyistä uhreista on kriittisessä tilassa, kun taas neljän muun vammat eivät viranomaisten tämänhetkisen arvion mukaan ole hengenvaarallisia. Yliopiston mukaan tapaukseen liittyi useita epäiltyjä. Tapaus käynnisti kampuksella sulkutilan ja usean viranomaisen yhteisen tutkinnan.

## Ampuminen tapahtui asuntoloiden ulkopuolella

Poliisit saapuivat kampuksen opiskelija-asuntoloiden ulkopuolelle noin kello 1.28 paikallista aikaa eli kello 5.28 GMT-aikaa. Paikalta löydettiin viisi ampumahaavoja saanutta ihmistä, ja heidät kaikki kuljetettiin alueen sairaaloihin. Tapahtumapaikaksi ilmoitettiin Quad Annexes -asuntoloiden ympäristö.

Chesterfieldin piirikunnan poliisin mukaan yhden uhrin vammoja pidettiin aluksi hengenvaarallisina. Myöhemmässä päivityksessä hänen tilansa kuvattiin kriittiseksi. Neljän muun uhrin vammojen ei arvioitu uhkaavan henkeä.

Yliopisto kertoi ampumiseen liittyneen useita epäiltyjä. Tapahtuman jälkeen kampus asetettiin väliaikaiseen sulkutilaan, ja alueella olevia kehotettiin välttämään ampumispaikan ympäristöä sekä noudattamaan lainvalvontaviranomaisten ohjeita.

Sulkutila päättyi noin kello 8.30 lauantaiaamuna. Poliisin toiminta kampuksella ei kuitenkaan päättynyt rajoituksen purkamiseen, sillä yliopisto kertoi alueelle jääneen huomattavan määrän lainvalvontaviranomaisia. Tapahtumapaikan tutkinta jatkui.

## Tutkinnassa mukana useita viranomaisia

Tutkintaa johtaa Chesterfieldin piirikunnan poliisi. Sitä avustaa Virginia State Universityn oma poliisi. Mukana ovat myös Hanoverin piirikunnan sheriffinvirasto sekä liittovaltion alkoholi-, tupakka-, ampuma-ase- ja räjähdevirasto ATF. Yliopiston mukaan tutkintaan osallistuu lisäksi muita paikallisia lainvalvontaviranomaisia.

Ampuminen sattui juuri ennen syyslukukauden opetuksen alkua. Opiskelija-asuntolat olivat avautuneet viikkoa aiemmin. Varsinaiset oppitunnit eivät olleet vielä alkaneet, vaan opetuksen oli määrä käynnistyä maanantaina.

Poliisi ei ollut lauantaina kertonut, oliko ketään otettu kiinni. Uhrien henkilöllisyyksiä ei ole julkistettu, eikä viranomaisilta ollut saatu tietoa siitä, mikä ampumiseen johti. Tapahtumien tarkka kulku ja epäiltyjen roolit olivat yhä selvitettävinä.

Police responded to the area outside of residence halls around 1:30 a.m. and found five people with gunshot wounds. They were taken to the hospital, and one is in critical-condition. The others had injuries that weren't life-threatening. The campus, which had not started fall-semester classes yet, was put on lockdown until about 8:30 Saturday morning. But police have not said if anyone has been arrested. Residence halls opened a week ago, and classes are set to begin Monday. Multiple suspects were involved in the incident in the early hours of Saturday, the university said.
